levels.title: H A P P Y   B I R T H D A Y
levels.riddle: A plate, two presents, three candles, a party hat and a balloon. Somebody is a year older.
levels.hint: Tip the pile back a little. The presents are the layers, the plate sits underneath and the balloon floats on the right.

levels.title: B O N   V O Y A G E
levels.riddle: A map, two boarding passes, two luggage tags, sunglasses and a camera. Time to leave.
levels.hint: Tip the pile a long way forward. The rolled map is the body, the tickets are wings and the tags are the tail.

levels.title: G O O D   M O R N I N G
levels.riddle: A pan, an egg, strawberries, cheese, a spatula, a whisk, a ladle and two forks. Someone is up before you.
levels.hint: Lean the pile back and keep turning. The pan is a body, the egg a head, the utensils fan out as a tail and the forks stand like feet.

levels.title: H O M E
levels.riddle: An open book, a cushion, a story book, a slipper, a candle and the house keys. Two lamps, one pose, two pictures.
levels.hint: Both walls must be right at once. One wall wants something you love, the other the place you keep it.
levels.complete:
HOME
Home is where the heart is.
